newsitem.title: USA: Kmart January U.S. same stores sales up.
newsitem.headline: Kmart January U.S. same stores sales up.

text.p: Kmart Corp said Thursday same-store sales for its U.S. Kmart stores rose eight percent in January from a year ago.
January same-store sales for all Kmart stores, including Builders Square, were up 7.2 percent.
Kmart store sales in the U.S. for the 13 weeks ended January 29 rose 5.6 percent on a comparable store basis, the company said. For all of Kmart, they were up 4.8 percent.
Kmart said total consolidated sales for the four weeks ended January 29 amounted to $1.95 billion, up 5.4 percent from $1.85 billion.
"Kmart's sales performance was satisfactory through the quarter," Floyd Hall, chairman, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.

Separately, Kmart announced it plans to close a 112,000 square-foot store located on 18211 Plymouth Road in Detroit by April 30. Kmart said the store, which first opened in 1962, has not been profitable for the past five years.
The store's 120 employees will receive eligible benefits when the store closes and will have the opportunity to apply for other Kmart job openings at area stores, the firm said.
Kmart also announced it will invest approximately $500,000 in its store located at 3900 East Outer Drive in Detroit.
